semiconductor_relevance: High — Nanotech Digital GmbH develops and manufactures equipment and materials specifically for the semiconductor industry, focusing on advanced technologies like graphene.
summary: Nanotech Digital GmbH specializes in the development and production of materials and equipment for the semiconductor, display, and battery industries. Their offerings include transparent electrodes using graphene technologies and various semiconductor process equipment, including CVD and ALD systems.
capabilities: CVD and ALD process equipment for semiconductors
Rapid thermal process equipment and sputtering systems
X-ray inspection and scanning electron microscopes

regional_presence.Korea: Nanotech Digital partners with Korean manufacturers for equipment and component technologies.
